en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Abdullah Bin Jundab, from a man from his companions, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:
‘Nine-tenths of the livelihood is with the owner of the animal’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Sinan from ‘Abd Allah ibn Jundab has said that narrated to him certain persons of our people who have said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Nine-tenths of sustenance is with the owner of a stumper.’”
